verdict.line: You lose only if you all-in while Shen's Feint (W) shield is up and let him block the burst for free; you win once you land Death's Grasp and stretch the fight long enough for Darkness Rise to trigger.

brief.thesis: Shen has no slow, root, or disengage dash in lane — only W (Feint)'s temporary damage shield and an E (Shadow Dash) that taunts him into exactly the melee range Mordekaiser wants. Once you land E (Death's Grasp) there is nothing stopping you from free-casting Q (Obliterate) and autos until Darkness Rise procs. That structural gap is why this reads as a measured 51.3% over 150 games with lane and solo-kill advantage both on your side, not an even fight.

theirWindow.when: his Feint (W) is up before engage
theirWindow.what: He can absorb one burst window for free, so don't dump Q/E into a shield. Poke with autos and Q first and wait for Feint to go on cooldown (9/8/7/6/5s) before committing.

yourWindow.what: Immediately follow with Q (Obliterate) and autos — Shen has no tool to break the pull or escape, so this is your window to stack three hits for Darkness Rise's damage aura and move speed and just keep swinging.

start.why: 52.3% win rate over 149 games and the standard 78% pick — the extra sustain and mana keep you throwing Q and E on cooldown through every trade window.

boots.why: 46.7% over 105 games and the majority pick (57.4%) — Shen's auto-resets off Ki Strike and his life-tap Q both lean on repeated hits, so the flat auto reduction blunts his sustain pattern in extended trades.

core.why: First item in the dominant build path (57.1% over 28 games) — the slow on Q/E lets you stay stuck to him through the whole Darkness Rise window.
Second in that same path — omnivamp sustains you through his Q life-tap healing and the true damage ramp punishes long trades he can't escape.
Closes out the most-picked core (21.1% pick) — burn damage keeps ticking through his Feint shield instead of being absorbed outright.

situational.when: he builds lifesteal or healing to out-sustain your trades
you want more stickiness through his taunt-timed disengages
the matchup turns into a long poke war instead of all-in trades

runes.keystoneWhy: The stacking adaptive force rewards exactly the extended-trade pattern E (Death's Grasp) sets up — the longer Shen is stuck fighting you, the more it ramps.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is the dominant pick at 70.5% with a 53.7% win rate — Ignite seals solo kills once you've pulled him in with E and he has no slow to peel away with.

playing.title: Bait before you pull
playing.detail: Don't open with E (Death's Grasp) while Shen's Feint (W) is up — poke with Q and autos first so his shield is on cooldown (9/8/7/6/5s) when you actually commit.

playing.title: Chain E into Q every time
playing.detail: Once E lands there's no root or slow stopping your follow-up — land Q (Obliterate) immediately for the bonus single-target damage.

playing.title: Fish for three hits
playing.detail: Darkness Rise needs three landed attacks or spells on a champion — stack autos between Q and E so the damage aura and move speed are live before the trade ends.

playing.title: Let his taunt happen
playing.detail: Shen's E (Shadow Dash) taunts you into melee range, which is exactly where you win — don't waste Flash dodging it, just keep swinging.

playing.title: Save R for isolation
playing.detail: Realm of Death (R) at level 6 lets you drag him away from minions and vision — use it to force solo duels where his stat theft can't be bailed out by a teammate.

playing.title: Don't overextend under his turret
playing.detail: OP.GG's own read holds here — you out-damage him everywhere except under enemy tower, so don't force the all-in that deep.

playing.title: Consume W only to heal, not to block
playing.detail: Indestructible (W) stores damage you deal and take — hold the shield through the trade and pop it for the heal once you're disengaging, not mid-combo.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, rune, summoner, and win-rate numbers are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the trade-pattern reasoning and timing calls are my own read of the kit.

stats.opponentTip: Shen is an easy opponent to lane against, with you always dealing more damage unless you are under enemy turret. Maintain your [P] active while prolonging the fight.
